webmentions.content: Hey, I am an international student myself, and since mid-2018 I've been using ING as my Dutch bank of my choice, recommended primarily by non-EU students in my class - as of today, they have information in English on the website, their app is available in English (the messages are in Dutch, but with google translate is not a problem), would personally recommend, since for students their services are free, and staff will assist you in English if you ask nicely.
